title: AggregatesBatch
description: A batch of per-interval, per-route aggregates sent by an agent to the cloud (POST /v0/aggregates).

protocol.description: Protocol version this batch conforms to. Every published minor of v0 stays acceptable.

observers.description: Absent from an instrumentation older than protocol 0.7.0. Absent is not 'nothing is observed': it is 'this one did not say', and the two must not be shown alike.

id.description: Random identifier generated once per process.

version.description: Deployed version or commit; "unknown" when undetectable.

dependencies.description: One entry per dependency this route touched. Replaces `postgres` (ADR 0011).

LatencyHistogram.title: LatencyHistogram
LatencyHistogram.description: Fixed-bucket latency histogram in milliseconds. counts[i] is the number of requests with latency <= boundaries[i]; the last bucket holds everything above the last boundary. Fixed buckets add up across instances.

PostgresStats.title: PostgresStats
PostgresStats.description: DEPRECATED since 0.4.0, use `dependencies` with kind `postgres` (ADR 0011). Still accepted, and translated at ingest, so agents on 0.2.x and 0.3.x keep working. Will be removed in v1. Its buckets are the same as Dependency's, declared there.

queriesPerRequest.description: Requests per bucket of queries-per-request; bounds in x-queries-per-request-boundaries, last bucket open-ended.

totalMs.description: Sum of query durations (ms) across every request on this route.

RuntimeHealth.title: RuntimeHealth
RuntimeHealth.description: What the runtime itself was doing. Every field is optional and at least one has to be there: `product.md:251` says the protocol is independent of the language, and a Go runtime has garbage collection, a heap and a resident set but no event loop. Requiring the six of them meant it could either invent an event loop or send none of the three it does have. An empty object is not a reading, hence the minimum of one (gh-285).

eventLoopDelayMs.description: How long the event loop was late, in ms. The signal that says the process itself is the bottleneck.

gcPauseMs.description: Total time spent in garbage collection during the interval.

heapUsedMb.description: Heap in use at the end of the interval.

rssMb.description: Resident set size at the end of the interval.

inFlightMax.description: Peak concurrent in-flight requests during the interval.

Dependency.title: Dependency
Dependency.description: What one request did against one dependency, aggregated over the interval for this route. The same shape for every kind, so the cloud stores and compares them uniformly (ADR 0011).

kind.description: What kind of dependency this is.

target.description: Host for outgoing HTTP (`api.stripe.com`); empty when the dependency is a single one, like the application's own database.

callsPerRequest.description: Requests per bucket of calls-per-request; bounds in x-calls-per-request-boundaries, last bucket open-ended.

totalMs.description: Sum of call durations (ms) across every request on this route.

waitMs.description: Time requests spent waiting to be able to talk to this dependency, on top of the time spent talking to it: a saturated connection pool shows up here and nowhere else. Optional; agents that cannot see it omit it.

Profile.description: What each route normally does, sent once a minute rather than with every interval: a profile changes when the code changes, and at the aggregates' cadence it would not fit in the project's row budget (ADR 0017).

start.description: Profile window start, Unix epoch milliseconds.

Operation.description: One thing this route does, identified by a hash and labelled by an optional normalised text. The hash is the identity, so suppressing the text keeps the analysis whole (ADR 0017, invariant 5).

kind.description: What kind of operation this is.

hash.description: Stable identity of the operation, or `(other)` for the bucket that holds the rest.

text.description: Normalised text, e.g. `SELECT id FROM products WHERE id = ?`. Optional: a user who would rather not send it keeps the whole analysis, only without the label.

count.description: Executions across every request on this route.

totalMs.description: Sum of their durations, in milliseconds.

distinct.description: Only on the `(other)` bucket: how many distinct operations it merges, so a cap does not become a lie by omission.

ObserverState.title: ObserverState
ObserverState.description: Whether an observer is attached (`on`), was not asked for (`off`), or was asked for and could not attach (`unavailable`) — a driver that is not resolvable from the application's root, for instance. The third one is the point: without it, a service that is not being watched looks exactly like a service that has nothing to watch (COB-01, invariant 14).

Observers.title: Observers
Observers.description: What the instrumentation is watching, by switch. The keys are the switches of `DOWNTRACE_INSTRUMENT`, so this says `pg` where a dependency says `postgres`: one is the switch and the other is the thing observed.
